q: The closing lemma (Pugh, 1967) states that for a C¹ vector field, any recurrent orbit can be:
opts: Proved to be periodic by structural stability
Closed (made periodic) by an arbitrarily small C¹ perturbation of the vector field
exp: Pugh's C¹ closing lemma: if x is a nonwandering point (equivalently, a recurrent point in many settings) of a C¹ flow, there is a C¹-small perturbation making x periodic. This connects the nonwandering set to periodic orbits but fails for C² (Gutierrez counterexample).
